name: Satu Visi Putra Tbk.
summary: PT Satu Visi Putra Tbk operates as a wholesale distributor of various materials for the advertising and printing industries throughout Indonesia. Their extensive product catalog features PVC panels, diverse ink formulations such as T-ink, Alwin, and Flora, and a wide array of banners, including Chinese and German backlite, German frontlite, matte, super glossy, and flexible options. The company also supplies an assortment of display hardware like brochure stands, tripods, door frames, and roll-up, X-frame, and Y-frame banners, in addition to TC coated and sublimation fabrics. Further offerings comprise promotional event desks, Chinese adhesive decals, textile banners, Alwin brand cleaning solutions, and One WayVision, a specialized self-adhesive film designed for glass applications. Founded in 2018, PT Satu Visi Putra Tbk is headquartered in Surabaya, Indonesia.
